Definition: of uncertain affinity; compassion (human or divine, especially active):--(+ tender) mercy.
BiblicalUsage: éleos means mercy, compassion. In Matthew 9:13, the text says "I will have mercy." In Luke 1:50, the text says "And his mercy [is] on them that fear him from generation to generation."
TheologicalSignificance: Reading éleos this way, I believe God's mercy is not a vague feeling but something He does — He sees need, and He acts on it. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: Mary Visits Elizabeth; The Calling of Matthew
